apps.name: Luma
apps.subtitle: Recovery, running, HYROX and fuelling from your WHOOP.
apps.localizedDescription: Luma reads a WHOOP strap you own directly over Bluetooth and turns it into recovery, sleep and strain each morning, GPS running with splits and spoken cues, HYROX race mode and readiness, a food and supplement log, and a coach. Your data stays on the phone; the coach runs on your own Anthropic key and reads only what you let it. A personal, non-commercial build on open-source foundations, credited in the app's About screen; not affiliated with WHOOP or HYROX.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 20. Race your last time, keep your races, share a result. Race your last time: a live HYROX session shows how far ahead or behind your last effort of the same kind you are, beside the target, and the voice says it after each run and station. Races: HYROX, Races, Add a race. Type the splits from your results page (4.35 for 4:35) or take a picture of the page and Luma copies the times for you to check. A race is kept once it adds up, and then it feeds your station bests and the prediction like a simulation. Side by side: a race report sets the effort beside the one before it: the whole difference, where the most time was won and lost, and every run and station. Share: Race report, Share this result makes a picture of the result with its splits. Fixed: after Undo in a live race the ahead or behind figure counted the undone segment twice. Fixed: deleting a session now takes its station bests with it.
